scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/worker.js && node --check src/standings-worker.js && node --check src/published-standings.js && node --check src/schema-bootstrap.js && node --check src/statewide-initializer.js && node --check src/schedule-response-normalizer.js && node --check src/record-rebuild.js && node --check src/school-branding.js && node --check src/school-branding-curated.js && node --check src/school-branding-curated-sync.js && node --check src/d1-usage-monitor.js && node --check src/d1-usage-public-worker.js && node --check ../live-data.js && node --check ../school-follow-logic.js && node --check ../team-detail.js && node --check ../school-schedule.js && node --check ../school-logo-ui.js && node --check ../standings.js && node --test test/*.test.js budget-tests/*.test.js
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run check && wrangler d1 execute localbleachersar-sports --remote --command="WITH source_game_counts AS (SELECT src.id,COUNT(g.id) AS game_rows FROM sources src JOIN teams t ON t.id=src.team_id JOIN schools sch ON sch.id=t.school_id LEFT JOIN games g ON g.source_id=src.id WHERE sch.level='college' AND sch.catalog_scope='local' AND t.season='2026' AND t.active=1 AND src.enabled=1 GROUP BY src.id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS enabled_sources,SUM(CASE WHEN game_rows>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS populated_sources,SUM(CASE WHEN game_rows=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_game_sources,COALESCE(SUM(game_rows),0) AS total_game_rows FROM source_game_counts" --json > ../m4-population-status-9a4f3d2c.json && wrangler deploy
